svg.text: RANGMANCH COSTUME BIBLE: MALWAI COTTON ANGARKHA (COST_001)
Character: CHAR_001 (Bada Kunwar Amar) | Scenes: SC01

foreignObject.div:
Textile & Ornamentation Details:
Studio wardrobe laydown shot. Handspun unbleached Malwa khadi cotton angarkha with side-tie tasselled chords. Traditional saffron bandhani border, paired with loose dhoti. Elder cotton pagdi in saffron folds with subtle zari hem. Studio lighting on neutral gray linen.

svg.text: Status: APPROVED & VERIFIED | Regional Craftsmanship: Malwa Weaves
